captions.detailed: An agricultural tractor front driven axle featuring a central dark-grey differential housing and a wide rectangular support beam. On both ends of the beam, steering knuckles are connected via vertical revolute kingpin joints, allowing left and right steering articulation. Mounted on each knuckle is a grey wheel hub assembly with a circular bolt pattern, which is designed to rotate continuously around its horizontal spindle axis.
captions.instruction: Generate an agricultural tractor front driven axle with a wide central beam, two steering knuckles connected via vertical revolute kingpins, and two wheel hubs on continuous rotational joints.
captions.factory: The code constructs a central axle beam using a box primitive combined with a central sphere and cylinder for the differential housing. It attaches vertical pivot cylinders at both ends of the beam. It defines left and right steering knuckles using a combination of vertical sleeves (cylinders) and rectangular brackets (boxes), connected to the axle via revolute joints. Finally, it models the wheel hubs as stepped cylinders with small bolt cylinders on their face, mounted to the knuckle spindles via continuous rotational joints.
